method: transcript-only; bounded recognized role headers; unknown roles retained
limitations: Role header discovery is bounded to first 96 records / 2MiB; no matching header means unattributed.
Only Claude transcript corpus is included. Codex history is not represented.
Live transcript reads are not filesystem snapshots; later reruns can differ if source files are edited. Input membership and cutoff are frozen here.
These are historical usage counts, not fixed-prefix or role-v1 acceptance evidence.
serialization: Complete metadata objects; array entries serialized one per line. Parsed values equal collector output.
